# Protect streamable HTTP transport from DNS rebinding

## Problem

Apps built with `fastmcp.server.http.create_streamable_http_app` (and `FastMCP.http_app()` / `FastMCP.run_http_async()` using the `http`/`streamable-http` transport) accept requests regardless of their `Host` or `Origin` headers. A malicious web page can use DNS rebinding to reach a locally running MCP server and initialize a session. Requests with an untrusted Host or Origin must be rejected before they reach the MCP endpoint, so no session is created and no `mcp-session-id` header is returned.

## Required behaviour

Host/Origin protection is **on by default** for streamable HTTP apps. It applies to every HTTP request (non-HTTP ASGI scopes pass through).

**Host validation.** The `Host` header (port ignored; IPv6 in brackets handled; case-insensitive) must match one of:
- the defaults `127.0.0.1`, `localhost`, `::1`;
- any entry in `allowed_hosts` (shell-style wildcards supported; `*` allows any host);
- the host the server is bound to, unless it is an unspecified address such as `0.0.0.0`.

Otherwise respond with status **421** and body `Misdirected Request`.

**Origin validation.** If an `Origin` header is present, it is accepted when any of these is true:
- it matches an entry in `allowed_origins` (wildcards supported; `*` allows any);
- both the origin's host and the request's Host are loopback (e.g. origin `http://localhost:3000` against Host `127.0.0.1`);
- it equals the request's own origin (request scheme + Host), comparing scheme, host and port after normalisation. Default ports count as 80/443, so `https://mcp.example.com` matches `https://mcp.example.com:443`. A different scheme or port does not match.

Otherwise respond with status **403** and body `Forbidden Origin`. A loopback origin is rejected for a non-loopback Host unless it is listed in `allowed_origins`. Requests with no `Origin` header skip this check.

## Configuration

`create_streamable_http_app` gains these keyword parameters:
- `host_origin_protection: bool = True`
- `allowed_hosts: Sequence[str] | None = None`
- `allowed_origins: Sequence[str] | None = None`

When `host_origin_protection=False`, no Host/Origin validation is done. This guard does not configure CORS. CORS must be configured separately when browser JavaScript has to read cross-origin responses.

`FastMCP.http_app(...)` and `FastMCP.run_http_async(...)` accept the same three parameters, each defaulting to `None`. For streamable HTTP, a `None` value falls back to these new settings on `fastmcp.settings`:
- `http_host_origin_protection: bool = True`
- `http_allowed_hosts: list[str] | None = None`
- `http_allowed_origins: list[str] | None = None`

These settings can be set through the usual `FASTMCP_` environment variables. The SSE transport is unchanged.

+DEFAULT_ALLOWED_HOSTS = ("127.0.0.1", "localhost", "::1")
+_DEFAULT_PORTS = {"http": 80, "https": 443, "ws": 80, "wss": 443}

+
+def _split_host(value: str) -> tuple[str | None, int | None]:
+    """Parse a Host header or URL authority into (lowercase host, port)."""
+    try:
+        parts = urlsplit(f"//{value}")
+        return parts.hostname, parts.port
+    except ValueError:
+        return None, None
+
+
+def _is_loopback(host: str | None) -> bool:
+    if not host:
+        return False
+    if host == "localhost":
+        return True
+    try:
+        return ipaddress.ip_address(host).is_loopback
+    except ValueError:
+        return False
+
+
+def _is_unspecified(host: str) -> bool:
+    if not host:
+        return True
+    try:
+        return ipaddress.ip_address(host).is_unspecified
+    except ValueError:
+        return False
+
+
+class HostOriginProtectionMiddleware:
+    """Reject HTTP requests with untrusted Host or Origin headers.
+
+    Protects against DNS rebinding. This does not configure CORS.
+    """
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        app: ASGIApp,
+        allowed_hosts: Sequence[str] | None = None,
+        allowed_origins: Sequence[str] | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        self.app = app
+        self.allowed_hosts = [h.lower() for h in (allowed_hosts or ())]
+        self.allowed_origins = [o.lower().rstrip("/") for o in (allowed_origins or ())]
+
+    def _host_allowed(self, raw: str, host: str | None) -> bool:
+        if host is None:
+            return False
+        return any(
+            fnmatchcase(host, pattern) or fnmatchcase(raw, pattern)
+            for pattern in (*DEFAULT_ALLOWED_HOSTS, *self.allowed_hosts)
+        )
+
+    def _origin_allowed(
+        self,
+        origin: str,
+        scheme: str,
+        raw_host: str,
+        host: str | None,
+        port: int | None,
+    ) -> bool:
+        normalized = origin.lower().rstrip("/")
+        if any(fnmatchcase(normalized, pattern) for pattern in self.allowed_origins):
+            return True
+
+        try:
+            parts = urlsplit(normalized)
+            origin_host, origin_port = parts.hostname, parts.port
+        except ValueError:
+            return False
+        if not origin_host or not parts.scheme:
+            return False
+
+        if _is_loopback(origin_host) and _is_loopback(host):
+            return True
+
+        if host is None:
+            return False
+        req_scheme = scheme.lower()
+        req_port = port if port is not None else _DEFAULT_PORTS.get(req_scheme)
+        if origin_port is None:
+            origin_port = _DEFAULT_PORTS.get(parts.scheme)
+        return (parts.scheme, origin_host, origin_port) == (req_scheme, host, req_port)
+
+    async def __call__(self, scope: Scope, receive: Receive, send: Send) -> None:
+        if scope["type"] != "http":
+            await self.app(scope, receive, send)
+            return
+
+        request = Request(scope)
+        raw_host = request.headers.get("host", "").strip().lower()
+        host, port = _split_host(raw_host)
+
+        if not self._host_allowed(raw_host, host):
+            await Response("Misdirected Request", status_code=421)(scope, receive, send)
+            return
+
+        origin = request.headers.get("origin")
+        if origin is not None and not self._origin_allowed(
+            origin, scope.get("scheme", "http"), raw_host, host, port
+        ):
+            await Response("Forbidden Origin", status_code=403)(scope, receive, send)
+            return
+

+import httpx
+import pytest
+
+import fastmcp
+from fastmcp import FastMCP
+from fastmcp.server.http import create_streamable_http_app
+from fastmcp.utilities.tests import temporary_settings
+
+INIT = {
+    "jsonrpc": "2.0",
+    "id": 1,
+    "method": "initialize",
+    "params": {
+        "protocolVersion": "2025-03-26",
+        "capabilities": {},
+        "clientInfo": {"name": "t", "version": "1"},
+    },
+}
+
+
+async def post(app, host: str, origin: str | None = None, scheme: str = "http"):
+    headers = {"host": host, "accept": "application/json, text/event-stream"}
+    if origin is not None:
+        headers["origin"] = origin
+    async with app.router.lifespan_context(app):
+        transport = httpx.ASGITransport(app=app)
+        async with httpx.AsyncClient(
+            transport=transport, base_url=f"{scheme}://{host}"
+        ) as client:
+            return await client.post("/mcp", json=INIT, headers=headers)
+
+
+def make_app(**kwargs):
+    return create_streamable_http_app(FastMCP("t"), "/mcp", **kwargs)
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    "host", ["localhost", "LOCALHOST:8000", "127.0.0.1", "[::1]:80"]
+)
+async def test_default_hosts_allowed(host):
+    response = await post(make_app(), host)
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+    assert "mcp-session-id" in response.headers
+
+
+async def test_untrusted_host_rejected():
+    response = await post(make_app(), "evil.example.net")
+    assert response.status_code == 421
+    assert response.text == "Misdirected Request"
+    assert "mcp-session-id" not in response.headers
+
+
+async def test_allowed_hosts_wildcard():
+    app = make_app(allowed_hosts=["*.corp.test"])
+    assert (await post(app, "a.corp.test:9")).status_code == 200
+    assert (await post(app, "evil.test")).status_code == 421
+
+
+async def test_allowed_hosts_star():
+    assert (
+        await post(make_app(allowed_hosts=["*"]), "anything.test")
+    ).status_code == 200
+
+
+async def test_protection_disabled():
+    app = make_app(host_origin_protection=False)
+    assert (await post(app, "evil.test", "http://evil.test:1")).status_code == 200
+
+
+async def test_loopback_origin_on_loopback_host():
+    response = await post(make_app(), "127.0.0.1", "http://localhost:3000")
+    assert response.status_code == 200
+
+
+async def test_foreign_origin_rejected():
+    response = await post(make_app(), "localhost", "http://evil.test")
+    assert response.status_code == 403
+    assert response.text == "Forbidden Origin"
+
+
+async def test_loopback_origin_rejected_for_non_loopback_host():
+    app = make_app(allowed_hosts=["mcp.example.com"])
+    response = await post(app, "mcp.example.com", "http://localhost:3000")
+    assert response.status_code == 403
+    app = make_app(
+        allowed_hosts=["mcp.example.com"], allowed_origins=["http://localhost:3000"]
+    )
+    assert (
+        await post(app, "mcp.example.com", "http://localhost:3000")
+    ).status_code == 200
+
+
+async def test_same_origin_and_default_ports():
+    app = make_app(allowed_hosts=["mcp.example.com"])
+    ok = await post(app, "mcp.example.com", "https://mcp.example.com:443", "https")
+    assert ok.status_code == 200
+    wrong_scheme = await post(app, "mcp.example.com", "http://mcp.example.com", "https")
+    assert wrong_scheme.status_code == 403
+    wrong_port = await post(
+        app, "mcp.example.com", "https://mcp.example.com:8443", "https"
+    )
+    assert wrong_port.status_code == 403
+
+
+async def test_allowed_origins_wildcard():
+    app = make_app(allowed_origins=["https://*.app.test"])
+    assert (await post(app, "localhost", "https://x.app.test")).status_code == 200
+

+    assert (await post(app, "svc.test")).status_code == 200

+        app = FastMCP("t").http_app()
+    assert (await post(app, "evil.test")).status_code == 200

+

+
